study.question: Does retaining a low-order position/content moment inside each temporal/target-relation unit recover useful information that its current commutative weighted sum discards?
study.hypothesis: Observed source limitation: the parent computes target-dependent but position-independent per-event weights; permutations confined to a temporal quartile leave every relation sum/count and raw global bypass unchanged (in exact arithmetic). A centered chronological rank moment of the same full event values can distinguish such histories without adding tokens or widening the readout. Its usefulness is untested. Recency versus pooled trajectories motivate retaining temporal detail; semantic atomic fields did not beat replica_seven, and added joint feedback counts failed to beat the relation-content parent, so neither more named field tokens nor extra feedback frequencies alone is established as useful. Quantitative trajectory review: DIN0.8099233881; recency_slots0.8183804941 versus pooled_slots0.8166562308 and later replica_recency0.8184713731 versus replica_pooled0.8123747586; atomic_fields0.8195094317 and coordinate_partition0.8189680279 did not exceed replica_seven0.8197867255. Relation-content/count factorial11=0.8275704846,10=0.8262472009,01=0.8200779142,00=0.8197867255. Its explicit-count increment is0.0013233 on relation content but0.0002912 on replicas; interaction is preliminary single-seed evidence. Latest joint0.8265676062 and independence0.8265172085 differ by only0.0000504 and both lose to zero0.8275704846; marginal0.8248097208 also loses. Latest declared source use therefore did not demonstrate a useful feedback-conjunction mechanism. No execution failures appear in the authorized trajectory; retain unsuccessful scientific branches without describing them as runtime failures. Parent minus DIN per-task AUC deltas: click+0.0145400609,cart+0.0179986204,fav+0.0140327151,buy+0.0240169895; Logloss deltas:-0.0017760289,-0.0021906003,-0.0015037289,-0.0014808746. Parent empty-history macro0.7222056057 versus DIN0.7268428930 (6444 samples, task positives427/45/28/13) remains a limitation; this proposed order path cannot directly fix no-history inputs. Parent history>64 macro0.8502786780 (1401885 samples) versus DIN0.8273443710 is observational motivation, not an independent randomized mechanism contrast. No recorded gains establish generalization to a new holdout or online mature feedback.

study.proposed_difference: Add one zero-initialized bias-free shared value_width-to-token_dim projection after all inherited parameter initialization. Its input is a second weighted full-event summary per existing unit, using a chosen coefficient from centered unit-RMS linear ranks, centered unit-RMS squared ranks, all-one visible coefficients, or zeros. Compute ranks inside the existing temporal bins, not elapsed time, and compute added reductions in FP32 before casting to parent token dtype. Keep counts, validity, original summaries, output dimensions and default loss unchanged. Four standalone modules differ only in moment_mode. No unverified novelty claim.
predictions: Predeclared primary: linear_moment exceeds both copy_moment and zero_moment on validation four-task macro AUC. Gains are provisional at one seed; select any winner using the frozen rule, never a slice or click-only score.

Structural diagnostic using common nonzero probe projection: swapping two different valid events inside the same temporal quartile leaves parent/copy/zero summaries unchanged but can change linear moments; squared moments are even under reversal. A global reversal can change quartile assignments and is not a valid parent-invariance check.

Empty histories and singleton temporal bins have zero linear/quadratic moment. With identical inherited parameters, empty-history predictions and initial predictions of all arms equal parent. Retrained empty-slice predictions can differ through shared parameters and do not constitute direct history information.

Report existing history-length bins empty,1-16,17-64,>64 with all task sample/positive/negative counts. Expect more opportunity in >64; this is a secondary exploratory trend, not a veto. No new frequency/time/composition slice will be fabricated without authorized statistics.
Expected nominal parameters32948357 (parent32944773 +112*32=3584); embedding count unchanged31793216, dense1155141. Host measurements, not these arithmetic estimates, determine actual cost.
falsifiers: No validation macro AUC advantage over zero or active copy control leaves the proposed useful-information claim unsupported.
Copy matching or exceeding linear suggests extra parameterization/optimization or content rescaling rather than retained order explains any improvement.

Quadratic matching linear supports a broader within-bin basis only; no unique first-moment explanation. Reversed linear coefficients are merely a sign reparameterization and deliberately are not used as an independent control.

Nonzero parent/copy change in an exact synthetic within-quartile permutation, or added linear insensitivity on a deliberately nondegenerate probe, falsifies the implementation claim; use tolerances for floating-point sums.
Masked-ID/current-action perturbation dependence, nonfinite moments, wrong labels/shapes or zero-control parent mismatch invalidates the comparison.
